messages.telegram.title: Telegram connection
messages.telegram.subtitle: Journal from Telegram — same account, same journal, same analysis.
messages.telegram.settings.title: Settings
messages.telegram.settings.subtitle: Your account, connections and preferences.
messages.telegram.state.disconnectedNote: Your Telegram account is not connected to Velora yet.
messages.telegram.state.connectingNote: A secure link was created. Press Start in Telegram to finish connecting. The link works once.
messages.telegram.state.connectedNote: Your Telegram account is connected. Every journal you confirm in Telegram lands in this web journal.
messages.telegram.state.revokedNote: The previous connection was revoked. Create a fresh secure link to connect again.
messages.telegram.state.expiredNote: The previous link expired. Create a new one.
messages.telegram.state.errorNote: The connection status could not be read. Try again.
messages.telegram.unlinkConfirm: Disconnect Telegram? Journal entries you already confirmed stay in your journal.
messages.telegram.notConfigured: Telegram is not enabled on this installation. This section activates once the bot is configured.
messages.telegram.step2: 2. Press Start in Telegram (the link is completed server-side).
messages.telegram.step3: 3. Journal by text, voice or screenshot and confirm.
messages.telegram.noPassword: Never type your password or a login code into Telegram. Velora will never ask for one.
messages.telegram.channel.title: Journal channel (optional)
messages.telegram.channel.none: No channel bound. Run /channel in Telegram to bind one.
messages.telegram.channel.canPostNo: The bot may not post in this channel; automatic mirroring is inactive.
messages.telegram.error.startFailed: Could not create the secure link. Try again.
messages.telegram.error.alreadyLinked: This account is already connected. Refresh the status.
